steps.title: Review Melbourne Bioinformatics dataset
steps.instruction: This is the data and associated metadata file for the Melbourne Bioinformatics workshop (https://mdhs.unimelb.edu.au/melbournebioinformatics/teaching-and-training), Introduction to Metabarcoding using QIIME2 - Mammal Dataset. There are 38 samples in this dataset from the short-beaked echidna Tachyglossus aculeatus. 5 samples from each individual (3x male and 3x female). 8 control samples (DNA extraction blanks (n=5) and PCR blanks (n=3))

substeps.instruction: Access the data and associated metadata file for the Melbourne Bioinformatics workshop.
Confirm there are 38 samples from the short-beaked echidna Tachyglossus aculeatus.
Verify 5 samples from each individual (3x male and 3x female).
Check for 8 control samples (5 DNA extraction blanks and 3 PCR blanks).
